umm sumtin weird happened..  QS sent u switch message.. then u responded to that it it didnt SHOW ur reponse but spoke it. and now ur last reponse was not spoken, but shown...
==================================================

messages.speaker: 🔮 GPT
messages.text:
🎩 Cozmo — yep, that’s a real QS synchronization bug, not your imagination.
I see a likely weak point: QS displays the exact clean response it extracted, but the GPT native-voice routine then independently says “find the latest assistant response” and clicks Read Aloud. Those two paths are not actually bound to the same response. A render/update at the wrong moment can therefore produce:
response A → spoken
response A → not displayed / cleared
response B → displayed
response B → not spoken
That’s exactly the kind of crossed-wire behavior you just described.
I would fix the contract so the voice action is tied to the exact response text QS just extracted, rather than simply “whatever is latest in the DOM.” That makes display and speech refer to the same state-machine transition instead of two independent notions of “latest.”
